component.name: Contact
component.description: Site-wide footer with the 'Connect' heading, a short freelance pitch, and direct links (email, phone, LinkedIn, Instagram). Has no props; copy and links are hardcoded.

useCases: page-ending CTA on narrative pages (index, project detail)
anchor target for the #connect nav link

commonPatterns.name: end-of-page
commonPatterns.description: Always render as the last child below page sections.

antiPatterns.scenario: rendering more than once on a page
antiPatterns.reason: id="connect" must be unique; nav anchors would land on the first instance only.

antiPatterns.scenario: hardcoding new contact links inline elsewhere
antiPatterns.reason: Drifts from the canonical list; updates miss sites.
antiPatterns.alternative: Edit Contact.astro so every page picks up the change.

antiPatterns.scenario: using em dashes in body copy
antiPatterns.reason: Project copy style avoids em dashes.

parentConstraints: should be the last section so the #connect anchor lands at page end

interactions.scrollReveal: Picked up by the .animate observer in the page script and revealed when 15% in view

accessibility.screenReader: Renders as <footer>; section label is the visible 'Connect' heading
accessibility.focusManagement: External links open in new tab with rel="noopener noreferrer"

aiHints.context: Use on any page that should end with the standard contact block. Don't duplicate; don't reinvent inline.
